description: Defines the CertNetFetcher interface for fetching certificate-related URLs (AIA, CRL, OCSP) in a network security context, including request handling and shutdown procedures.

classes.name: CertNetFetcher
classes.description: Interface for fetching certificate URLs, supporting asynchronous requests, shutdown, and cancellation.

classes.name: CertNetFetcher::Request
classes.description: Represents an individual fetch request, allowing waiting for completion and retrieving results.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the fetcher and cancels ongoing requests; must be called from the network thread.

methods.name: FetchCaIssuers
methods.description: Starts a fetch for CA issuer URLs, returns a request object.

methods.name: FetchCrl
methods.description: Starts a fetch for CRL URLs, returns a request object.

methods.name: FetchOcsp
methods.description: Starts a fetch for OCSP URLs, returns a request object.
